title: Profile and Watch - Gmail API
query: Can you grab my profile info real quick and stop watching my mailbox? I don't need live updates right now.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Lists the drafts in the user's mailbox

maxResults.description: Maximum number of drafts to return (default: 100, max: 500)

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Sends the specified draft to the recipients in the To, Cc, and Bcc headers

draftId.description: The ID of the draft to send

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Lists the messages in the user's mailbox

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return

ids.description: Array of message IDs to delete

enableAutoReply.description: Flag that controls whether Gmail automatically replies to messages

responseBodyPlainText.description: Response body in plain text format

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Gets the current user's Gmail profile

tools.name: stop_user_watch
tools.description: Stop receiving push notifications for changes to the user's mailbox

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: Lists all labels in the user's mailbox

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Immediately and permanently deletes the specified label and removes it from any messages

labelId.description: The ID of the label to delete

tools.name: create_filter
tools.description: Creates a filter for incoming emails

action.description: Action to perform when a message matches the criteria

explanation: The user is asking for two things: (1) 'grab my profile info' maps to get_user_profile, and (2) 'stop watching my mailbox' / 'don't need live updates' maps to stop_user_watch. Both functions require no parameters. This is a multi-function call scenario.
hints: The user wants TWO different things done - look for functions that match each request
Both functions take no parameters (empty object)
